sn35.248:1.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave yavakalāpī catumahāpathe nikkhittā assa ||
sn35.248:1.3: te taṃ yavakalāpim chahi vyābhaṅgīhi haneyyuṃ ||
sn35.248:1.4: evaṃ hi sā bhikkhave yavakalāpī suhatā assa chahi vyābhaṅgīhi haññamānā || ||
sn35.248:1.6: so taṃ yavakalāpiṃ sattamāya vyābhaṅgiyā haneyya ||
sn35.248:1.7: evaṃ hi sā bhikkhave yavakalāpī suhatatarā assa sattamāya vyābhaṅgiyā haññamānā || || 4
sn35.248:1.8: Evam eva kho bhikkhave assutāvā puthujjano cakkhusmiṃ haññati manāpāmanāpehi rūpehi || la ||
sn35.248:1.11: sace so bhikkhave assutavā puthujjano āyatipunabbhavāya ceteti || evaṃ hi so bhikkhave moghapuriso suhatataro hoti || seyyathāpi bhikkhave sā yavakalāpī sattamāya vyābhaṅgiyā haññamānā || || 5
sn35.248:2.2: Atha kho bhikkhave Vepacitti asurindo asure āmantesi ||
sn35.248:2.3: sace mārisā devāsurasaṅgāme samupabbūḷhe asurā jineyyuṃ || devā parājineyyuṃ || yena taṃ Sakkaṃ devānam indam kaṇṭhe pañcamehi bandhanehi bandhitvā mama santike āneyyātha asurapuranti || ||
sn35.248:2.4: Sakko pi kho bhikkhave devānam indo deve Tāvatiṃse āmantesi || ||
sn35.248:2.5: Sace mārisā devāsurasaṅgāme samupabbūḷhe devā jineyyuṃ asurā parājineyyuṃ || yena naṃ Vepacittim asurindaṃ kaṇṭhe pañcamehi bandhanehi bandhitvā mama santike āneyyātha Sudhammaṃ devasabhanti || || 6
sn35.248:2.6: Tasmiṃ kho pana saṅgāme devā jiniṃsu asurā parājiniṃsu || ||
sn35.248:2.7: Atha kho bhikkhave devā Tāvatiṃsā Vepacittim asurindaṃ kaṇṭhe pañcamehi bandhanehi bandhitvā Sakkassa devānam indassa santike ānesuṃ Sudhammaṃ devasabhaṃ || || 7
sn35.248:2.8: Tatra sudam bhikkhave Vepacitti asurindo kaṇṭhe pañcamehi bandhanehi baddho hoti || ||
sn35.248:2.9: Yadā ca kho bhikkhave Vepacittissa asurindassa evaṃ hoti ||
sn35.248:2.10: Dhammikā kho devā adhammikā asurā idheva dānāham devapuraṃ gacchāmīti ||
sn35.248:2.11: atha kaṇṭhe pañcamehi bandhanehi muttam attānaṃ samanupassati || dibbehi ca pañcahi kāmaguṇehi samappito samaṅgībhūto paricāreti || ||
sn35.248:2.12: Yadā ca kho bhikkhave Vepacittissa asurindassa evaṃ hoti
sn35.248:2.13: Dhammikā kho asurā adhammikā devā tattheva dānāham asurapuraṃ gamissāmīti ||
sn35.248:2.14: atha kaṇṭhe pañcamehi bandhanehi baddham attānaṃ samanupassati || dibbehi ca pañcahi kāmaguṇehi parihāyati || || 8
sn35.248:2.17: maññamāno kho bhikkhave baddho Mārassa amaññamāno mutto pāpimato ||
sn35.248:3.1: Asmīti bhikkhave maññitam etaṃ Ayam aham asmīti maññitam etaṃ Bhavissan ti maññitam etaṃ Na bhavissan ti maññitam etaṃ || Rūpī bhavissan ti maññitam etaṃ Arūpī bhavissan ti maññitam etaṃ Saññī bhavissan ti Asaññī bhavissan ti maññitam etam Nevasaññīnāsaññī bhavissan ti maññitam etaṃ ||
sn35.248:3.2: maññitam bhikkhave rāgo maññitaṃ gaṇḍo maññitam sallaṃ || ||
sn35.248:3.3: Tasmāti ha bhikkhave amaññitamānena cetasā viharissāmāti || || 9
sn35.248:4.1: Asmīti bhikkhave iñjitam etaṃ Ayam aham asmīti iñjitam etam Bhavissan ti iñjitam etaṃ Na bhavissan ti iñjitam etaṃ || Rūpī bhavissan ti iñjitam etaṃ Arūpī bhavissan ti iñjitam etam Saññī bhavissan ti iñjitam etaṃ Asaññī bhavissanti iñjitam etaṃ Nevasaññināsaññī bhavissan ti iñjitam etaṃ ||
sn35.248:4.2: iñjitam bhikkhave rāgo iñjitaṃ gaṇḍo iñjitaṃ sallaṃ || ||
sn35.248:4.3: Tasmā ti ha bhikkhave aniñjamānena cetasā viharissāmāti || || 10
sn35.248:5.1: Asmīti bhikkhave phanditam etaṃ Ayam aham asmīti phanditam etaṃ Bhavissan ti || pa || Na bhavissan ti || Rūpī bhavissan ti || Arūpī bhavissan ti || Saññī bhavissan ti || Asaññī bhavissan ti || Nevasaññīnāsaññī bhavissan ti phanditam etaṃ ||
sn35.248:5.2: phanditam bhikkhave rāgo phanditaṃ gaṇḍo phanditam sallaṃ || ||
sn35.248:5.3: Tasmā ti ha bhikkhave aphandamānena cetasā viharissāmāti || || 11
sn35.248:6.1: Asmīti bhikkhave papañcitam etaṃ Ayam aham asmīti papañcitam etam || Bhavissan ti || pa || Na bhavissan ti || Rūpī bhavissan ti || Arūpī bhavissan ti || Saññī bhavissan ti || Asaññī bhavissan ti || || Nevasaññīnāsaññī bhavissan ti papañcitam etaṃ || ||
sn35.248:6.2: Papañcitam bhikkhave rāgo papañcitaṃ gaṇḍo papañcitaṃ sallaṃ || ||
sn35.248:6.3: Tasmāti ha bhikkhave nappapañcena cetasā viharissāmāti || || 12
sn35.248:7.1: Asmīti bhikkhave mānagatam etaṃ Ayam aham asmīti mānagatam etaṃ || Bhavissan ti mānagatam etaṃ Na bhavissan ti mānagatam etaṃ || Rūpī bhavissan ti mānagatam etaṃ || Arūpī bhavissan ti mānagatam etaṃ || Saññī bhavissan ti mānagatam etaṃ || Asaññī bhavissan ti mānagatam etaṃ || || Nevasaññīnā saññī bhavissan ti mānagatam etaṃ || ||
sn35.248:7.2: Mānagatam bhikkhave rāgo mānagataṃ gaṇḍo mānagataṃ sallaṃ || ||
sn35.248:7.3: Tasmā ti ha bhikkhave nihatamānena cetasā viharissāmā ti || || Evaṃ
